title: Generalized Volterra Companion Operators on Bergman Spaces over Convex Domains of Finite Type
summary: We study generalized Volterra companion operators on Bergman spaces over smoothly bounded convex domains of finite type. A derivative Carleson embedding gives boundedness and compactness criteria between reflexive Bergman spaces. When the target exponent is smaller than the source exponent, boundedness already implies compactness. In the other range, we also obtain an essential-norm formula.
